purpose: Independent commit-reveal evaluation of the frozen epoch20 one-bit missing-sensor cognition with explicit custodian binding of question and prediction stage hashes.

candidate.sensor_input_schema: arte.independent_sensor_input/v57 with v3 top-level stage-binding fields

hidden_package.allowed_positive_domain: the five frozen ambiguity signatures only
hidden_package.negative_controls: malformed or out-of-bank observations may be included with expected_action=HOLD

chronology.event: External custodian creates all G1/G2/G3 exact hidden UTF-8 packages and independent random OTP keys, then publishes only one three-generation commitment batch.

Formal freeze is created only after commitment intake and binds the exact v3 pre-freeze snapshot, authority policy, candidate, bank, intake, freeze generator, per-generation verifier, aggregate verifier, public spec, and commitment batch.
Custodian releases the exact precommitted public packet for one generation after validating the formal freeze self-hash.
Candidate runs network-off and produces questions. The canonical question-output SHA-256 is sent to the custodian.
Custodian verifies the exact questions against the hidden package and returns sensor_input containing formal_freeze_sha256 and question_output_sha256. A wrong question causes no sensor release.
Candidate runs network-off and produces predictions. The canonical prediction-output SHA-256 is sent to the custodian.
Custodian returns a reveal object containing the OTP key plus formal_freeze_sha256, question_output_sha256, sensor_input_sha256, and prediction_output_sha256.
v3 final verifier decrypts the original hidden package and checks every commitment, freeze self-hash, snapshot binding, stage hash, question, sensor bit, prediction, target, and HOLD control.

why_stage_hashes_matter.question_binding: The custodian sensor response cryptographically identifies the exact question-output object received before sensor release.
why_stage_hashes_matter.prediction_binding: The custodian key reveal cryptographically identifies the exact prediction-output object received before target/key release.
why_stage_hashes_matter.limitation: Cryptographic hash binding alone is not an independent wall-clock authority; the chronological claim becomes evidence only when the custodian itself is independently controlled and its provenance is verified.
